Episode: 1
Episode Logline: A waitress learns the billionaire she just insulted is her new landlord.

SCENE 1
Scene heading: INT. DINER – NIGHT
Scene start: 00:00:00,00
Scene end: 00:00:52,00

ACTION:
[00:00:00.50 - 00:00:03.00]
Maya slams a coffee pot down in front of a man in a grey suit. Coffee splashes onto his cuff.

MAYA (Furious):
[00:00:03.10 - 00:00:05.40]
"You think money makes you better than us?"

ETHAN (Cold, Amused):
[00:00:05.60 - 00:00:07.20]
"No. It makes me your landlord."

SOUND FX:
[00:00:07.20 - 00:00:09.00]
A plate shatters on the floor. The whole diner goes silent.

MAYA:
[00:00:09.50 - 00:00:12.00]
"Get out of my diner."

ETHAN (Smirking):
[00:00:12.30 - 00:00:16.00]
"Your diner? Read the lease you signed this morning."

ACTION:
[00:00:16.00 - 00:00:22.00]
Maya grabs the lease from the counter. Her hands shake as she reads the name at the bottom.

MAYA (Shocked, Whispering):
[00:00:22.50 - 00:00:25.00]
"Ethan Cole... you bought the whole street?"

ETHAN (Menacing):
[00:00:25.50 - 00:00:30.00]
"And by Friday, you'll beg me to let you stay."

CAMERA:
[00:00:30.00 - 00:00:34.00]
Slow push-in on Maya's face as tears gather but she refuses to look away.

MAYA (Defiant):
[00:00:34.50 - 00:00:38.00]
"I would rather burn this place down."

ACTION:
[00:00:38.00 - 00:00:45.00]
Ethan leans in close, then freezes as he sees the locket around her neck.

ETHAN (Stunned):
[00:00:45.50 - 00:00:48.50]
"Where did you get that locket?"

SOUND FX:
[00:00:48.50 - 00:00:52.00]
Ominous drone swells. Cut to black.
